G5500.et: from a comparative of (5495) and teino (to stretch)
G5500.def: from a comparative of «5495» and teino (to stretch); to be a hand-reacher or voter (by raising the hand), i.e. (generally) to select or appoint:--choose, ordain.

G5501.def: irregular comparative of «2556»; from an obsolete equivalent cheres (of uncertain derivation); more evil or aggravated (physically, mentally or morally):--sorer, worse.

G5502.def: plural of Hebrew origin («03742»); "cherubim" (i.e. cherubs or kerubim):--cherubims.

G5503.et: feminine of a presumed derivative apparently from the base of (5490) through the idea of deficiency
G5503.def: feminine of a presumed derivative apparently from the base of «5490» through the idea of deficiency; a widow (as lacking a husband), literally or figuratively:--widow.

G5504.def: of uncertain derivation; "yesterday"; by extension, in time past or hitherto:--yesterday.

G5506.def: from «5507» and «757»; the commander of a thousand soldiers ("chiliarch"; i.e. colonel:--(chief, high) captain.

G5507.def: plural of uncertain affinity; a thousand:--thousand.

G5508.def: of uncertain derivation; Chios, an island in the Mediterranean:--Chios.

G5509.def: of foreign origin («03801»); a tunic or shirt:--clothes, coat, garment.

G5510.et: perhaps akin to the base of (5490) ((5465)) or (5494) (as descending or empty)
G5510.def: perhaps akin to the base of «5490» («5465») or «5494» (as descending or empty); snow:--snow.

G5511.def: of uncertain derivation; a military cloak:--robe.

G5512.def: from a derivative probably of «5491»; to throw out the lip, i.e. jeer at:--mock.

G5514.def: feminine of apparently a primary word; "green"; Chloe, a Christian female:--Chloe.

G5515.def: from the same as «5514»; greenish, i.e. verdant, dun-colored:--green, pale.

G5516.pos: 1. six hundred and sixty six, the meaning of which is the basis of much vain speculation
G5516.et: the (22)d, (14)th and an obsolete letter ((4742) as a cross) of the Greek alphabet (intermediate between the (5)th and (6)th), used as numbers
G5516.def: the 22nd, 14th and an obsolete letter (4742 as a cross) of the Greek alphabet (intermediate between the 5th and 6th), used as numbers; denoting respectively 600, 60 and 6; 666 as a numeral:--six hundred threescore and six.

G5517.def: from «5522»; dusty or dirty (soil-like), i.e. (by implication) terrene:--earthy.

G5518.def: of uncertain derivation; a choenix or certain dry measure:--measure.

G5520.def: from «5521»; to be bilious, i.e. (by implication) irritable (enraged, "choleric"):--be angry.

G5521.et: from an equivalent perhaps akin to the same as (5514) (from the greenish hue)
G5521.def: feminine of an equivalent perhaps akin to the same as 5514 (from the greenish hue); "gall" or bile, i.e. (by analogy) poison or an anodyne (wormwood, poppy, etc.):--gall.

G5522.def: from the base of «5494»; a heap (as poured out), i.e. rubbish; loose dirt:--dust.

G5523.def: of uncertain derivation; Chorazin, a place in Palestine:--Chorazin.

G5524.def: from a compound of «5525» and «71»; to be a dance-leader, i.e. (generally) to furnish:--give, minister.

G5525.def: of uncertain derivation; a ring, i.e. round dance ("choir":--dancing.

G5526.def: from «5528»; to fodder, i.e. (generally) to gorge (supply food in abundance):--feed, fill, satisfy.

G5528.def: apparently a primary word; a "court" or "garden", i.e. (by implication, of pasture) herbage or vegetation:--blade, grass, hay.

G5529.def: of uncertain origin; Chuzas, an officer of Herod:--Chuza.

G5530.et: middle voice of a primary verb (perhaps rather from (5495), to handle)
G5530.def: middle voice of a primary verb (perhaps rather from «5495», to handle); to furnish what is needed; (give an oracle, "graze" (touch slightly), light upon, etc.), i.e. (by implication) to employ or (by extension) to act towards one in a given manner:--entreat, use. Compare «5531»; «5534».

G5531.et: probably the same as the base of (5530)
G5531.def: probably the same as the base of «5530»; to loan:--lend.

G5532.def: from the base of «5530» or «5534»; employment, i.e. an affair; also (by implication) occasion, demand, requirement or destitution:--business, lack, necessary(-ity), need(-ful), use, want.

G5533.def: from a derivative of «5531» and «3781»; a loan-ower, i.e. indebted person:--debtor.

G5534.et: third person singular of the same as (5530) or (5531) used impersonally
G5534.def: third person singular of the same as «5530» or «5531» used impersonally; it needs (must or should) be:--ought.

G5535.def: from «5532»; to make (i.e. have) necessity, i.e. be in want of:--(have) need.

G5536.def: something useful or needed, i.e. wealth, price:--money, riches.

G5537.def: from «5536»; to utter an oracle (compare the original sense of «5530»), i.e. divinely intimate; by implication, (compare the secular sense of «5532») to constitute a firm for business, i.e. (generally) bear as a title:--be called, be admonished (warned) of God, reveal, speak.

G5538.def: from «5537»; a divine response or revelation:--answer of God.

G5540.def: from «5530»; employment, i.e. (specially), sexual intercourse (as an occupation of the body):--use.

G5541.def: middle voice from «5543»; to show oneself useful, i.e. act benevolently:--be kind.

G5542.def: from a compound of «5543» and «3004»; fair speech, i.e. plausibility:--good words.

G5543.def: from «5530»; employed, i.e. (by implication) useful (in manner or morals):--better, easy, good(-ness), gracious, kind.

G5544.def: from «5543»; usefulness, i.e. morally, excellence (in character or demeanor):--gentleness, good(-ness), kindness.

G5545.def: from «5548»; an unguent or smearing, i.e. (figuratively) the special endowment ("chrism") of the Holy Spirit:--anointing, unction.

G5546.def: from «5547»; a Christian, i.e. follower of Christ:--Christian.

G5547.def: from «5548»; anointed, i.e. the Messiah, an epithet of Jesus:--Christ.

G5548.et: probably akin to (5530) through the idea of contact
G5548.def: probably akin to «5530» through the idea of contact; to smear or rub with oil, i.e. (by implication) to consecrate to an office or religious service:--anoint.

G5549.def: from «5550»; to take time, i.e. linger:--delay, tarry.

G5550.def: of uncertain derivation; a space of time (in general, and thus properly distinguished from «2540», which designates a fixed or special occasion; and from «165», which denotes a particular period) or interval; by extension, an individual opportunity; by implication, delay:--+ years old, season, space, (X often-)time(-s), (a) while.

G5551.et: from a presumed compound of (5550) and the base of (5147)
G5551.def: from a presumed compound of «5550» and the base of «5147»; to be a time-wearer, i.e. to procrastinate (linger):--spend time.

G5552.def: from «5557»; made of gold:--of gold, golden.

G5553.def: diminutive of «5557»; a golden article, i.e. gold plating, ornament, or coin:--gold.

G5554.def: from «5557» and «1146»; gold-ringed, i.e. wearing a golden finger-ring or similar jewelry:--with a gold ring.

G5555.def: from «5557» and «3037»; gold-stone, i.e. a yellow gem ("chrysolite"):--chrysolite.

G5556.def: from «5557» and prason (a leek); a greenish-yellow gem ("chrysoprase"):--chrysoprase.

G5557.et: perhaps from the base of (5530) (through the idea of the utility of the metal), gold
G5557.def: perhaps from the base of «5530» (through the idea of the utility of the metal); gold; by extension, a golden article, as an ornament or coin:--gold.

G5558.def: from «5557»; to gild, i.e. bespangle with golden ornaments:--deck.

G5559.et: probably akin to the base of (5530) through the idea of handling
G5559.def: probably akin to the base of «5530» through the idea of handling; the body (properly, its surface or skin):--body.

G5560.def: apparently a primary word; "halt", i.e. limping:--cripple, halt, lame.

G5561.et: from a derivative of the base of (5490) through the idea of empty expanse
G5561.def: feminine of a derivative of the base of «5490» through the idea of empty expanse; room, i.e. a space of territory (more or less extensive; often including its inhabitants):--coast, county, fields, ground, land, region. Compare «5117».

G5562.def: from «5561»; to be in (give) space, i.e. (intransitively) to pass, enter, or (transitively) to hold, admit (literally or figuratively):--come, contain, go, have place, (can, be room to) receive.

G5563.def: from «5561»; to place room between, i.e. part; reflexively, to go away:--depart, put asunder, separate.

G5564.def: diminutive of «5561»; a spot or plot of ground:--field, land, parcel of ground, place, possession.

G5565.def: adverb from «5561»; at a space, i.e. separately or apart from (often as preposition):--beside, by itself, without.

G5566.def: of Latin origin; the north-west wind:--north west.

G5567.et: probably strengthened from psao (to rub or touch the surface, cf (5597))
G5567.def: probably strengthened from psao (to rub or touch the surface; compare «5597»); to twitch or twang, i.e. to play on a stringed instrument (celebrate the divine worship with music and accompanying odes):--make melody, sing (psalms).

G5568.def: from «5567»; a set piece of music, i.e. a sacred ode (accompanied with the voice, harp or other instrument; a "psalm"); collectively, the book of the Psalms:--psalm. Compare «5603».

G5569.def: from «5571» and «80»; a spurious brother, i.e. pretended associate:--false brethren.

G5570.def: from «5571» and «652»; a spurious apostle, i.e. pretended pracher:--false teacher.

G5571.def: from «5574»; untrue, i.e. erroneous, deceitful, wicked:--false, liar.

G5572.def: from «5571» and «1320»; a spurious teacher, i.e. propagator of erroneous Christian doctrine:--false teacher.

G5573.def: from «5571» and «3004»; mendacious, i.e. promulgating erroneous Christian doctrine:--speaking lies.

G5574.et: middle voice of an apparently primary verb
G5574.def: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to utter an untruth or attempt to deceive by falsehood:--falsely, lie.

G5575.def: from «5571» and a kindred form of «3144»; a spurious witness, i.e. bearer of untrue testimony:--false witness.

G5576.def: from «5575»; to be an untrue testifier, i.e. offer falsehood in evidence:--be a false witness.

G5578.def: from «5571» and «4396»; a spurious prophet, i.e. pretended foreteller or religious impostor:--false prophet.

G5580.def: from «5571» and «5547»; a spurious Messiah:--false Christ.

G5581.def: from «5571» and «3686»; untruly named:--falsely so called.

G5584.def: from the base of «5567» (compare «5586»); to manipulate, i.e. verify by contact; figuratively, to search for:--feel after, handle, touch.

G5585.def: from «5586»; to use pebbles in enumeration, i.e. (generally) to compute:--count.

G5586.def: from the same as «5584»; a pebble (as worn smooth by handling), i.e. (by implication, of use as a counter or ballot) a verdict (of acquittal) or ticket (of admission); a vote:--stone, voice.

G5587.et: from a derivative of psithos (a whisper
G5587.def: from a derivative of psithos (a whisper; by implication, a slander; probably akin to «5574»); whispering, i.e. secret detraction:--whispering.

G5588.def: from the same as «5587»; a secret calumniator:--whisperer.

G5589.et: diminutive from a derivative of the base of (5567) (meaning a crumb)
G5589.def: diminutive from a derivative of the base of «5567» (meaning a crumb); a little bit or morsel:--crumb.

G5590.def: from «5594»; breath, i.e. (by implication) spirit, abstractly or concretely (the animal sentient principle only; thus distinguished on the one hand from «4151», which is the rational and immortal soul; and on the other from «2222», which is mere vitality, even of plants: these terms thus exactly correspond respectively to the Hebrew «05315», «07307» and «02416»):--heart (+ -ily), life, mind, soul, + us, + you.

G5591.def: from «5590»; sensitive, i.e. animate (in distinction on the one hand from «4152», which is the higher or renovated nature; and on the other from «5446», which is the lower or bestial nature):--natural, sensual.

G5594.def: a primary verb; to breathe (voluntarily but gently, thus differing on the one hand from «4154», which denotes properly a forcible respiration; and on the other from the base of «109», which refers properly to an inanimate breeze), i.e. (by implication, of reduction of temperature by evaporation) to chill (figuratively):--wax cold.

G5595.def: from the base of «5596»; to supply with bits, i.e. (generally) to nourish:--(bestow to) feed.

G5596.et: diminutive from a derivative of the base of (5597)
G5596.def: diminutive from a derivative of the base of «5597»; a crumb or morsel (as if rubbed off), i.e. a mouthful:--sop.

G5597.et: prolongation from the same base as (5567)
G5597.def: prolongation from the same base as «5567»; to triturate, i.e. (by analogy) to rub out (kernels from husks with the fingers or hand):--rub.

G5598.def: the last letter of the Greek alphabet, i.e. (figuratively) the finality:--Omega.

G5599.def: a primary interjection; as a sign of the vocative case, O; as a note of exclamation, oh:--O.
